result:
**I'd make curiosity the fundamental operating system of every human mind.**

Not kindness (which follows from understanding), not peace (which emerges when we stop being terrified of each other), not even abundance. Just raw, relentless, joyful curiosity as the default setting.

Imagine a world where:
- The urge to *actually understand* something is stronger than the urge to win an argument about it
- People get the same dopamine hit from discovering how reality works as they currently get from owning or dominating
- "I don't know" becomes an exciting state instead of a threatening one
- Every ideology has to survive contact with evidence because the desire to be right is replaced by the desire to be *less wrong*

Everything else cascades from there. Better technology, less bullshit, fewer wars started by people who are certain about things that aren't true, more art, more wonder, more genuine connection.

The universe is already unspeakably strange and beautiful. We just need to stop flinching from it.

That's the one change. Everything good follows.
